Occupancy grid maps

Source: R/mapping.R
robot_occupancy_grid.Rd

Creates a 2D occupancy grid covering xlim by ylim with square cells of side resolution. Cells store log-odds of occupancy, initialized from the prior probability. Cell [i, j] covers x in xlim[1] + (j - 1, j) * resolution and y in ylim[1] + (i - 1, i) * resolution (rows are y, columns are x).

Usage

robot_occupancy_grid(xlim, ylim, resolution, prior = 0.5, occupied = NULL)

Arguments

xlim, ylim

World extents (m).

resolution

Cell size (m).

prior

Prior occupancy probability, strictly between 0 and 1.

occupied

Optional logical matrix to initialize a known map (TRUE is occupied) with probabilities 0.99 and 0.01.

Value

A robot_occupancy_grid.

Examples

g <- robot_occupancy_grid(c(0, 5), c(0, 3), resolution = 0.1)
g
#> <robot_occupancy_grid> 30 by 50 cells of 0.1 m covering [0, 5] x [0, 3]
